name: SOL late spot-confirmed favourite
description: Buys the SOL favourite (YES or NO) once per market with 4-6 minutes left, only when spot is at least 1.5 sigma (15-min realized vol) past the strike. Such favourites win more often than their ~95c ask implies; held to settlement.
hypothesis: SOL 15m favourites at tau 240-360 s priced ~95c with spot >=1.5 sigma beyond the strike win ~97-98%: screen (Jan-Aug, taker next fills net of fee) +2.9c at tau 360 (850 trades, se 0.44, 8/8 months), +2.1c at 240 (576, 8/8), +0.9c at 300 (864, 5/8). Other side: flat-vol quoters and favourite-longshot payers who pay for lottery tails or exit early. Wrong if the engine's thin depth and 150 ms latency remove it, <60% months positive, 2x latency negative, or it decays like sol-favbias.
